Home / Statistics / Finances

Income class, not a budget.

The municipal profile and the DTI CMCI both call Ibaan a second-class municipality. Neither publishes the town's annual income figure here, and no local budget or financial statement was found on the municipal site.

A classification band is not Ibaan's income. It is shown only as the CMCI definition.

On this page Income classWhat is not publishedWhere to go next

Second-class municipality

The CMCI defines second class as average annual income of ₱45,000,000 to ₱54,999,999. That is the definition of the band, not a reported figure for Ibaan.
